purpose: Teach: カヌー/画廊/怪人/鳥獣/合奏/ファインダー/随筆/ハサミ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんとカヌー体験ツアーに行きましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's go on that canoe tour with Dad, hmm?
lines.style: Warm, inviting tone. Speaking to a child with genuine interest. Soft opening on his name. Rising lilt on the question mark — including him, not telling him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、メイ姉さんの個展、画廊で観たいよ
lines.en: Mom, I really want to see Mei's exhibition at the gallery.
lines.style: Clear, earnest request. Not demanding — genuinely stating what matters to him. Direct eye contact. The quiet certainty of a child who knows what he wants.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、絵本の怪人が出てくるシーン、ドキドキするわね
lines.en: Sho, that monster scene in the picture book does make your heart race, doesn't it?
lines.style: Playful, conspiratorial acknowledgment. Animated but not overacting. A small smile in the voice. She's meeting him in his excitement, not dampening it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、社会で鳥獣戯画について勉強したよ
lines.en: Mom, I learned about the Choju Giga scrolls in social studies class.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost proud. He's sharing something he learned that matters. No performance — just offering the fact because it connects to what they were discussing.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが合奏会で太鼓を叩いて下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad is going to play the drums in the ensemble concert.
lines.style: Warm reflection. Speaking as if sharing a private pride. Gentle pace. A slight softness — she's noticing something good about her husband without making it dramatic.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんがカメラのファインダーから熱心に景色を撮ってらした
lines.en: Mom, Dad was really focused, taking pictures through the camera viewfinder.
lines.style: Quiet observation, almost wondering. He's noticed something in his father's intensity. No judgment — just describing what he saw. Slight hesitation, like he's still thinking about it.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが随筆を書いてみたいって仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad said he wants to try writing essays.
lines.style: Gentle sharing of news. She's passing along something her husband said, warmly. Reflective pace. A light touch — not over-explaining, just letting the thought land.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お母さんとハサミで折り紙切ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I cut origami with you using scissors.
lines.style: Warm, specific memory. He's offering this to her — a moment they shared. Gentle pride in the doing. A small, genuine smile in his voice. Closing note of contentment.
